conflicts.description: 2019 equity awards are split differently across proxies. The 2020 proxy SCT has no Option Awards column and reports the 2019 performance-based stock options inside Stock Awards (Swan $61,722,600; Davis $24,993,900; Renduchintala $21,977,400; Shenoy $22,168,700; Bryant $11,670,300). The 2021 and 2022 proxies split the same amounts into Stock Awards and Option Awards (Swan $44,622,600 + $17,100,000; Davis $18,195,900 + $6,798,000; Renduchintala $15,197,400 + $6,780,000; Shenoy $15,388,700 + $6,780,000; Bryant $9,127,800 + $2,542,500). Totals agree. Each filing is recorded as printed. Underwood's 2019 row (2020 proxy only) likewise has no separate option figure.

Underwood's interim-CFO dates (and so the end of Swan's CFO role): the 2019-01-31 8-K says he was appointed 'effective as of January 31, 2019' and his Form 3 event date is 2019-01-31, but the 2020 proxy says he served 'from February 1, 2019 through April 2, 2019'. The 2019-04-03 8-K has him stepping down 'as of the Effective Date' (2019-04-03), while the 2020 proxy says he ceased to be an executive officer on 2019-04-02. Recorded: Swan CFO to 2019-01-31; Underwood 2019-01-31 to 2019-04-02.

Rivera's executive-officer end: the 2024-01-03 8-K says she ceased to head DCAI 'effective as of December 31, 2023'; the 2024 proxy says she ceased to be an executive officer 'as of 2023 fiscal year-end', which was 2023-12-30. Recorded 2023-12-31 (the 8-K date).

Johnston Holthaus and Schell executive-officer starts: the 2024 and 2025 proxies say both 'assumed their NEO positions' on 2022-03-14 (Schell joined as EVP that day; the 2022-01-10 8-K had named Johnston Holthaus GM of CCG), but both Form 3s give 2022-04-13 as the date of the event requiring the statement. As with Form 3-only designations elsewhere, the executive-officer tenure starts 2022-04-13; the titles are about a month older.

Titles that predate the first Form 3: Renduchintala joined in November 2015 as EVP and President, Client and IoT Businesses and System Architecture Group (Form 3 2016-01-21); Shenoy is described as EVP and GM of the Data Center Group 'since May 2017' (the 2017-05-03 8-K still calls him SVP; Form 3 2017-11-15); Rodgers was General Counsel from June 2014 and EVP and GC from January 2017 but was not in the FY2017 10-K executive officer list (filed 2018-02-16) and his Form 3 is 2018-05-16. Executive-officer tenures start at the Form 3 dates (medium confidence).

Renduchintala's title change: the FY2019 10-K says he was named Group President and Chief Engineering Officer in April 2017, but the FY2017 10-K (filed 2018-02-16) still listed his original title. The title-change date is recorded as 2017-04 (month).

Rodgers' end as General Counsel: he notified Intel on 2022-02-05, and the 8-K (filed 2022-02-09) names an interim GC 'effective immediately'; the 2022 proxy says he ceased to be an executive officer on 2022-02-09. Recorded 2022-02-09. He retired from Intel 2022-05-31.

Bryant's end: the 2022-01-10 8-K says an interim CCG head took over 'effective immediately' and his resignation was effective 2022-01-31; the 2022 proxy says he ceased to be an executive officer on 2022-01-21 and his last day of employment was 2022-01-31. Recorded 2022-01-21.

PvP TSR base date is stated three ways for the same printed TSR values: 'December 31, 2019' (2023 proxy), 'December 29, 2019, the first day of fiscal year 2020' (2024 proxy) and 'December 27, 2019, the last trading day prior to the commencement of fiscal year 2020' (2025 proxy). Intel's fiscal 2019 ended 2019-12-28 (a Saturday), so 2019-12-27 was its last trading day. The TSR values for the years these proxies share are identical, so the base did not actually change. Each row keeps its own filing's stated date.

The 2026 proxy rebases TSR to $100 on 2020-12-24, so its values for 2021-2024 differ from earlier proxies (Intel 2021: $111.80 vs $89.75; 2022: $59.86 vs $48.06; 2023: $116.52 vs $93.55; 2024: $47.71 vs $38.30). The ratio is constant at about 1.2456 (= 100/80.28, the fiscal 2020 value on the old base), so this is a rebase, not a restatement. Peer values are rebased the same way. All recorded as filed.

Chandrasekaran's current title: the 2026 proxy says he was promoted to EVP, Chief Technology and Operations Officer and GM, Intel Foundry on 2025-02-15, while the FY2025 10-K says he has held that title 'since September 2025'. Both agree he was designated an executive officer only on 2025-11-20 (proxy and Form 3), which is where his tenure starts.
